description: Run a predefined spatial operation (buffer, intersect, union, clip, spatial join, proximity, dissolve) and persist derived results.

operation.description: The spatial operation to run. Single-layer: bounds, buffer, centroid, dissolve. Multi-layer: clip (target+mask), countPoints (polygons primary + points secondary), intersect, join, subtract (target-mask).

secondarySourceId.description: Second source for multi-layer operations. Omit (or pass empty string) for single-layer ops.

title.description: Human-readable title for the resulting derived layer.

name: project_run_spatial_operation
title: Run a project spatial operation
